match_questions: What was the survival rate in each passenger class?

responses.text: A single grouped SQL query answers this.

arguments.query: SELECT pclass, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(survived), 4) AS survival_rate FROM passengers GROUP BY pclass ORDER BY pclass

arguments.answer: Survival rate falls sharply outside first class. Class 1 survived at 0.6506, class 2 at 0.3797 and class 3 at 0.382, so a first-class passenger was roughly 1.7 times as likely to survive as anyone else. Classes 2 and 3 are within a percentage point of each other.
